subject: MedNova: post-call security follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@mednova.com>, MedNova Security <security@mednova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: MedNova: post-call security follow-up & next steps

Hi Alex / MedNova security team —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a clear plan: 

- Scope: Private/VPC deployment with option for air-gapped execution for PHI processing.
- Compliance ask: you flagged HIPAA + GDPR constraints and asked about Redwood's SOC 2 status and evidence readiness.
- Networking: you want a sample deployment diagram showing network isolation, NACLs, and optional air-gap staging.
- Procurement: you requested a vendor intake/questionnaire we can complete to speed procurement.

Immediate next steps I propose (with owners):
1) I will send our short private-deployment brief and SOC 2 evidence checklist (attached) — Lauren (me).
2) Ben will coordinate procurement milestones and share our standard DPA + high-level commercial timeline — Ben (cc).
3) Aditya will schedule a technical evidence sync to go over logs, key management, and deployment diagram options — Aditya (cc).

Can you confirm the date you expect SOC 2 Type II to be complete (or an expected quarter)? Also please attach the vendor intake you've started so we can pre-fill what we can.

Attachments: redwood_private_deploy_brief.pdf, redwood_soc2_evidence_checklist.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up call if you'd like to walk through the diagram options.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference for engineers
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@mednova.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>
Cc: MedNova Security <security@mednova.com>, Sara Nelson <sara.nelson@mednova.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T17:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedNova: post-call security follow-up & next steps

Lauren — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we are currently SOC 2 Type I in place; Type II rollup is in progress with an expected completion in Q4 2028. We can share the Type I report and the engagement letter for Type II.
- HIPAA/GDPR: we process PHI in scoped projects and will require Business Associate Agreement language + encryption in transit and at rest.
- Air-gap: the air-gapped option is primarily for one of our regulated clients; please include the offline deployment checklist and any known limitations (patching/updates cadence, monitoring blindspots).

I'm attaching the vendor intake we started — it's partial but should give you the initial fields to prefill (mednova_vendor_intake_partial.xlsx). We would also like an example network diagram that shows the VPC layout, subnets for model serving, and the recommended firewall/NAT boundaries.

Also can you send a copy of your standard DPA? Sara (cc) will triage the legal questions.

Thanks,
Alex Kim
Senior Product Manager, MedNova Health
alex.kim@mednova.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@mednova.com>, MedNova Security <security@mednova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedNova: post-call security follow-up & next steps

Alex — great, thanks for the quick answers and the partial intake.

I quoted your note below when assigning internal owners.

On 18 Jun 2028, Alex Kim wrote:
> SOC 2: we are currently SOC 2 Type I in place; Type II rollup is in progress with an expected completion in Q4 2028. We can share the Type I report and the engagement letter for Type II.
> HIPAA/GDPR: we process PHI in scoped projects and will require Business Associate Agreement language + encryption in transit and at rest.
> Air-gap: the air-gapped option is primarily for one of our regulated clients; please include the offline deployment checklist and any known limitations (patching/updates cadence, monitoring blindspots).

Ben — can you pick up the DPA + procurement milestones here? We should offer a draft DPA and our standard HIPAA addendum; Ben can coordinate a redline session if needed.

Aditya — can you own the technical evidence sync? Please prepare (a) a short SOC 2 evidence checklist we can attach, (b) a sample network diagram with a VPC + optional air-gap, and (c) a short note on key management integrations (KMS/HSM) for MedNova's security team. Target to have these artifacts ready by EOD Thursday (2028-06-22) so we can share ahead of the sync.

Alex / Sara — would a quick technical sync on Friday 2028-06-23 at 11:00 AM PT work for you? If yes I will send a calendar invite and attach the artifacts discussed.

Thanks all — leaning on Ben and Aditya to move the items.

Best,
Lauren
